facts.label: Problemas e motivos
facts.sub: Conte o que aconteceu no passado e dê o motivo com because + frase completa: I fell because the road was wet. Pergunte Why did you ride in the rain?

facts.label: Passado
facts.sub: Para contar o que aconteceu, use o passado: I fell yesterday. The wheel broke. I rode in the rain. Verbos irregulares: fall vira fell, break vira broke, ride vira rode.

facts.label: Porque
facts.sub: Use because para dar o motivo: I fell because the road was wet. Depois de because, escreva uma frase completa, com sujeito e verbo: because I was late.

pages.title: A small bike shop · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Tuesday afternoon in a small bike shop in Denver. Old tires hang on the wall. Alma cleans her hands with a rag. A red helmet sits on the table. Paulo walks in with his bike. One wheel looks very bad.
“Hi, Paulo. What’s wrong with your bike?” says Alma. “I fell yesterday because the road was wet.” says Paulo. “Oh no. Are you okay?” says Alma.

group: Professor é Alma; estudante faz o papel de cliente. Escolham as falas e refaçam a conversa em três rodadas.
